title: Copy a ticket form
purpose: Create a new ticket form from an existing one, with all its fields, to make a variant without building it again.
summary: Give the copy a name and, if you like, a key. It starts with every field of the original, is offered like the original but not on the service menu, and has its own tickets and history.

tasks.title: Make a variant of a form
steps: On the form's page select [[Copy form]].
Type the [[Name of the copy]] and, if you want a particular one, the [[Key]].
Select [[Copy form]], then edit the copy's fields and portal settings.

tasks.title: Leave without copying
steps: Select [[Cancel]] to return to the original form.

good_to_know: The copy keeps the field keys, labels, types, rules and order of the original, inactive fields included.
The copy's client label starts empty, so the portal shows its name until you set one.
Changing the copy never changes the original or the tickets raised with it.

items.label: Name of the copy
items.description: Required. What staff see, and what clients see until you give the copy a client label. It must differ from every other form's name.

items.label: Key
items.description: A stable code that never changes after creation. Leave it empty to make one from the name. It must differ from every other form's key.

items.label: Copy form
items.description: Creates the copy and opens its page. The change is recorded in each copied item's history.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the original form without copying.
